items.html: And against this world, called "her food" (She'era), is said "and the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations" (ve-haya shearit Yaakov ba-goyim) — for it is the aspect of the remnants (Shiurin) that remained in the first aspect of the three within three. And these remnants of holiness are called "the remnant of Jacob" (Sheerit Yaakov), which is in Assiya, where are all the Klipot and other gods (Elohim Acherim). And this is the secret of "and the remnant of Jacob shall be among the nations," which are the Klipot. And if you remember what was told to you in the secret of "and you shall say to the last generation" (ve-Amar ha-Dor Acharon), which is called the remnant of Jacob, being the aspect of "the legs reach the legs," you will understand this verse more. And that is enough (Ve-Dai Lach).
